shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 26 -B 3 '"'^## Page Constructor'"' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Text Button ThemeProvider && npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies --json"

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md && cat tsconfig.json && cat vite.config.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -i -C 2 'header|card|extended|content-layout|custom|animate|button' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs | rg 'header|card|extended|constructor|text'; sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts; rg -n -- '--g-color-base-(positive|neutral|background)|--g-color-text-(positive|light)|--g-text-display-4|--g-text-display-3' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.d.ts; sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BasicCard/BasicCard.js; rg -n -A 45 -B 3 'interface Custom|type CustomItems|interface PageContent|interface BaseBlock|interface HeaderBlock' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/*.d.ts; rg -n 'HeaderBlock|PageContent|BlockBase|Custom' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts; sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/Constructor/Constructor.js"

/bin/bash -lc "head -60 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/index.d.ts; head -55 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.js; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/CardBase/CardBase.css; sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.css; rg -n -A 32 'const Block|function Block|className:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Block.js"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/components/ConstructorItem/ConstructorItem.js; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/components/ConstructorBlocks/ConstructorBlocks.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/components/ConstructorItem/ConstructorItem.css; rg -n -- '--pc-container|--pc-grid|--pc-indent|--pc-border' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/*.scss | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 8 'enum Theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts; rg -n -A 8 'enum Indent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/*.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/components/ConstructorBlock/ConstructorBlock.css; rg -n -- '--g-spacing-10|--g-color-line-positive|--g-border-radius-xl' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -10"
